message.content:
# TOSTEM Website Layout & Design Analysis

## Overall Structure
The TOSTEM website features a clean, professional design with a focus on Japanese window design innovation. The layout follows a standard corporate website structure with a prominent header, navigation menu, hero section, and modal overlay for appointment booking.

## Navigation Structure
- **Header Navigation**: A dark gray (approximately #333333) horizontal navigation bar spans the full width below the logo
- **Menu Items**: 
  - "ABOUT TOSTEM" (with dropdown)
  - "WHY TOSTEM" (with dropdown)
  - "OUR PRODUCTS" (partially visible)
  - "TOSTEM EXPERIENCE" (with dropdown)
  - "REACH US" (with dropdown)
- **Logo**: "TOSTEM" in large, bold typography positioned at the top left
- **Tagline**: "Japanese Innovation in Window Design" in smaller text to the right of the logo
- **Call-to-Action Buttons**: 
  - "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE" (vertical black button on left side)
  - "ENQUIRE NOW" (vertical black button on right side)
  - Phone icon button (circular blue button on far right)

## Hero Section
- **Background**: Large, high-quality image showing people in what appears to be an office or showroom environment with large windows
- **Overlay**: Semi-transparent dark overlay (approximately 30% opacity) to improve text readability
- **Content**: The hero section is currently obscured by a modal dialog

## Color Scheme
- **Primary**: Dark gray (#333333) for navigation and text
- **Secondary**: White (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds and modal content
- **Accent**: Black (#000000) for buttons and important elements
- **Call-to-Action**: Blue (#2E5A87) for the phone icon button
- **Text**: Dark gray (#333333) for body text, white for modal headings

## Typography
- **Logo**: Bold, sans-serif font (likely a custom or modified version of Helvetica/Arial), large size, uppercase
- **Navigation**: Medium-weight sans-serif, uppercase, consistent spacing
- **Modal Heading**: Medium-weight sans-serif, centered, uppercase
- **Form Fields**: Regular sans-serif, placeholder text in light gray (#999999)
- **Submit Button**: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, white text on black background
- **Cookie Notice**: Small sans-serif, regular weight

## Modal Dialog (Appointment Booking)
- **Background**: White (#FFFFFF) with subtle shadow
- **Header**: 
  - "TOSTEM" logo at top center
  - "×" close button at top right
  - "BOOK AN APPOINTMENT" heading in medium-weight sans-serif, centered
- **Form Fields**:
  - "Enter your name" (full width text input)
  - "Enter your email address" and "Enter your mobile number" (side-by-side inputs)
  - "City" and "Select State" (side-by-side, with state as dropdown)
  - "Are you a" and "You are looking for" (side-by-side dropdowns)
- **Submit Button**: Black background with white "SUBMIT" text, full width

## Footer (Partially Visible)
- **Cookie Notice**: Light gray background with text about cookie usage
- **Buttons**: "Cookie settings" (white background, black text) and "ACCEPT" (black background, white text)

## Spacing & Layout
- **Modal**: Centered on screen with generous padding (approximately 40px)
- **Form Fields**: Consistent spacing with 16px vertical margins between fields
- **Button Sizes**: Submit button spans full width of modal with height approximately 48px
- **Text Alignment**: Centered for modal heading, left-aligned for form field labels
- **Responsiveness**: The layout appears designed for desktop first, with the modal being responsive to screen size

## Notable Design Elements
- **Dropdown Arrows**: Small downward-pointing arrows next to navigation items indicating expandable menus
- **Form Field Borders**: Light gray borders around all input fields
- **Shadow Effects**: Subtle shadow on modal to create depth
- **Consistent Spacing**: Uniform padding and margins throughout the design
- **Contrast**: High contrast between text and backgrounds for readability
- **Professional Aesthetic**: Clean lines and minimal design elements create a sophisticated corporate appearance

The design effectively communicates professionalism and innovation while providing clear pathways for user interaction through the appointment booking modal and navigation structure.
